index.title: Exclusion Management
index.descHtml: Manage items permanently excluded from assessment itself. While Exception Management is a temporary waiver (approval + period), an Exclusion removes structurally non-applicable items (e.g. daemons absent on the OS, items unnecessary by policy) from evaluation.
index.searchPh: 🔍 Search rule ID / server / reason / registrant

js.confirmToggle: Toggle the active state of this exclusion?

new.title: Register Exclusion
new.descHtml: Register items to permanently exclude from assessment. Use only when checking is structurally impossible or meaningless (e.g. daemon not installed on the OS, feature unused by policy). For a temporary waiver, use an Exception Request.

target.heading: Target Item
target.hostPh: e.g. jessy207 (may be empty for CSV batch)
target.acctPh: System accounts etc. (e.g. bin, daemon). Leave empty for whole host
target.csvPh:
hostname,account  (one per line)
jessy207,bin
jessy207,daemon
jessy167,   ← empty account = whole host
target.csvHelp: Exclude multiple hosts/accounts (e.g. system accounts) from the same check item at once. (CSV input overrides the single host/account above)

reason.heading: Exclusion Reason
reason.detailPh: Specific grounds for permanently excluding this item from assessment (for audit trail)
